Name: Fire Emblem Swords Pack
Author: HalberdierV2
Description:
This mod adds in Variations of the Falchion, Tyrfing, Alondite and Ragnell into Stardew Valley, purchasable at Marlon for various prices. the weapons are also priced relative to their damage output and other stats.

This requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] to run.

--UPDATE - 0.0.3 --

 -5 new weapons Added!
- LANCES ARE IN! Lance weapons are now a go!

Installation Info

-Unzip the .zip file into your Mods Folder located at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

- To Update, overwrite the old folder with the update.

To uninstall simply remove the folder from your Mods folder.
